comments.body: Working document for Wallet best practices: https://hackmd.io/@rimeissner/eip7702-best-practices

There seem to be some open points:
- Optional nonce
  - https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1052#issuecomment-2149029376 and https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-7702-set-eoa-account-code-for-one-transaction/19923/158 (same message, different forums)
- Signign Address vs Code
  - https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-7702-set-eoa-account-code-for-one-transaction/19923/157

The question around the nonce is probably very important to answer as this was part of the Execution Layer Meeting agenda for tomorrow.
